description: Get a token from the [Tencent Docs MCP manager](https://docs.qq.com/open/auth/mcp.html). Paste the token as issued; do not add Bearer.

en.description: Get a token from the [Tencent Docs MCP manager](https://docs.qq.com/open/auth/mcp.html). Paste the token as issued; do not add Bearer.
